title: fix(plugin-grid): keep draft-only fields out of a grouped grid's requests under draft preview
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBLW6dHPW6sSheA32XPKZzPV)_

repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzg2evNa1V3zxrQq3KX

Fixes #34898

Clause-②: yes — one new locale key (the visible "this grouping waits for publish" note the card's Expected names), locale-only; no spec, no new exported prop
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 改了什么：草稿预览下，分组表格不再向数据接口索要「只存在于草稿里的字段」；按这种字段分组时，表格改为不分组（或按剩下的已发布字段分组），并显示一行提示。
- 为什么改：之前草稿字段放在列里，每个分组都报 INVALID_FIELD；按草稿字段分组，整张表显示「Error loading grid」。
- 风险与回滚：只在字段带 `_draftOnly` 标记时生效，预览之外没有标记，行为不变；回滚即撤销本 PR。
- 先看：`objectGridGroupingDecisions.ts`（分组键剔除，和已有的掩码键剔除同一路径）、`objectGridRowLoad.ts`（`withoutDraftOnly` 与 `$expand` 过滤）、`ObjectGrid.tsx`（提示行）。
- 两分钟验证：`cd ui && pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-grid exec vitest run --root ../.. packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/serverGroupedDraftOnly-34898.test.tsx`，预期 7 个测试全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`@object-ui/plugin-grid` now reads the `_draftOnly` marker off the object definition it already fetches (`getObjectSchema`, `objectGridRowLoad.ts`), with module-private helpers and nothing new exported.

- **Columns.** A draft-only field is never projected: the whole row `$select` passes one last filter (`withoutDraftOnly`), so a column, a grouping key and every harvested operand (predicate, `referenceVia`, `dependsOn` and the rest) follow one rule, on the flat fetch and on every group's row page. A draft-only relation is also left out of `$expand`, because the door checks `$expand` names against the published object too. The column still draws, empty, under its draft label.
- **Grouping.** A draft-only grouping entry is refused the way a masked grouping key already is (`objectGridGroupingDecisions.ts`). It is dropped from `unmaskedGroupingFields`, so it is never sent as `groupBy`. It also counts nowhere in `serverGroupedFetch`, `groupingNeedsHeaderQuery` or the fetch-window choice. The grid groups by the published entries left, or draws ungrouped. `useServerGrouping.ts` needed no change: its `groupBy` comes from the server grouping fields, which come from `unmaskedGroupingFields`.
- **The note.** One line, `grid.grouping.draftOnly` ("Not grouped by FIELDS: it exists only in the draft until you publish."), naming each dropped field by its label. It is defined in `ObjectGrid.tsx` directly after the `grid.grouping.needsHeaderQuery` panel, and it is drawn under the description and above the rows, in the table branch and in the card view.
  - **Why there:** `needsHeaderQuery` is an early return that replaces the grid with an error panel. This case withholds nothing, so drawing it in that spot would hide the rows it explains. Drawing it above the rows, in the same muted strip `ListView` uses for its own draft-preview note (#34807 list half), means it is read before the rows and looks the same on both surfaces.
- **Locales.** The new key is added to `en` and the other 10 packs (zh-Hant regenerated with `gen-zh-hant.mjs`), and to `GRID_DEFAULT_TRANSLATIONS`, byte-identical to `en`.
- **After Publish.** The marker comes from the same definition read, so once the definition stops marking the field, the grouping and the column work on the next read with no reload.

## Why

Under `?preview=draft` the console's data source returns the published definition plus each field only the draft declares, marked `_draftOnly`. The data door still checks every `$select` and `groupBy` name against the published object (`assertProjectionFieldsExist`, `assertGroupByFieldsExist`). The grid built its own requests from that definition and treated the marked field as declared.

Premise, measured on origin/main `189358f212` before the fix (the grid source restored from that commit, the real `ObjectGrid`, and a double whose `getObjectSchema` marks `priority` `_draftOnly` and which refuses any request naming it):

- (A) Draft-only column, grouped by a published field: every group row page sent `$select` `["id","name","priority","category"]`, and both groups drew `INVALID_FIELD: select 'priority'`.
- (B) Grouped by a draft-only field: `queryGroupHeaders` got `groupBy: ["priority"]`, and the grid drew "Error loading grid".

## Tests

New file `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/serverGroupedDraftOnly-34898.test.tsx`, 7 pins. Its double projects rows the way the door does: only the selected keys come back.

- Draft-only column grouped by a published field: every group row page selects `['id','name','category']`, there are no group errors, the column header draws and its cells are empty, and no note shows.
- Draft-only column, ungrouped: the flat `$select` is `['id','name']`.
- CONTROL, the same column published: `['id','name','priority','category']`, and the values draw.
- Grouped only by a draft-only field: `queryGroupHeaders` is never called, there is no "Error loading grid", the grid draws flat, and the note names "Priority".
- Grouped by a draft-only field plus a published one: every `groupBy` is `['category']`, and the note names "Priority".
- CONTROL, the same grouping published: `groupBy` is `[['priority']]`, and no note shows.
- After Publish: the grid is re-rendered (never re-mounted) with a data source that answers for the published state, as leaving the preview does. Pinned by the note disappearing, `groupBy` `['priority']` arriving, the last row page selecting `priority`, and no errors.

## Acceptance notes

- **End-to-end preview depends on #34807's list half,** which supplies the marked schema under preview (`withUnpublishedObjectReads` in `ui/packages/app-shell/src/preview/unpublishedObjectReads.ts`). On origin/main nothing marks a field yet, so this PR is inert in the running console until that PR lands. The pins drive the grid with a marked definition directly.
- **Not measured, not fixed here (same class, outside this card's columns-and-grouping scope).** A header-click sort, an authored `sort`, `searchableFields` or a view `filter` that names a draft-only field would still reach the door from this grid. This is read from the code only. No repro was run, so nothing was filed.
- **i18n budget is tight.** On the merged tree (this branch plus origin/main `62fbbeb767`), `i18n-locale-en` reads 61,869 gzipped bytes against a 62,000 ceiling, leaving 131 bytes. The same build without this key reads 61,841, so the key costs +28 bytes. #34925, #34929 and the #34807 list half each add an `en` key too. Stacked, they may exceed the ceiling. The ceiling is not edited here. If it is exceeded, `grid.grouping.*` could move to a lazy namespace.
